user.title: Select a Tasmota device
user.description: Choose a device already set up in Home Assistant's Tasmota integration.

details.title: Confirm device details
details.description: Review the name and MQTT topic. If the topic is blank, enter it from the device's MQTT settings.

error.invalid_device: Select a device from the Tasmota integration.
error.invalid_topic: Enter only the device topic, for example sonoff_livingroom.

abort.unsupported_mqtt_layout: This device uses a custom MQTT layout. Schedule Manager requires the FullTopic setting %prefix%/%topic%/ and the cmnd and stat prefixes. Update the device's MQTT settings and try again.
